name: The Neverwhere Tales
source:
You grew up on the outskirts of town with parents who were always there for you.
After finishing school, you apply for and get a typical job.

Now, you're working your way up the career ladder and living the corporate life.
That all changes one day when you get a call from your mother.

You will learn that everything you believed to be true was a facade.
You are confronted with a world you have always considered fiction or movie material.

How you deal with this new situation, this new world, who you trust or not... that is up to you.​

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2639380/The_Neverwhere_Tales__Book_1/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你在郊区长大，父母总是在你身边。
完成学业后，你申请并获得一份典型的工作。

现在，你正在努力攀登职业阶梯并过着公司生活。
有一天，当你接到母亲的电话时，一切都改变了。

你会发现你所相信的一切都是假象。
你面临着一个你一直认为是小说或​​电影素材的世界。

你如何应对这个新情况，这个新世界，你信任谁或不信任谁……这取决于你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2639380/The_Neverwhere_Tales__Book_1/]Steam[/url]]
